title: The Moth on the Path
lines: Beth has a thin red hat.
Beth sits on the path with it.
A big moth sits on the hat.
The moth is thick and tan.
Then the moth hops off with it!

questions.listenFor: On the path. It is stated in the second line - have them find it rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why does Beth run up the path?
questions.listenFor: The moth went off with her hat. You want cause and effect, not just "she ran."

questions.ask: Do you think the moth took the hat on purpose? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason tied to the story, like "no, it just hopped off."
